body.x: Xandar Kardian, the global leader in radar sensor technology, announced a comprehensive partnership with Ceragem, a prominent global healthcare solutions company, at CES 2024 in Las Vegas on January 9th. The collaboration aims to explore innovative technological developments based on Xandar Kardian’s radar sensor technology through various dimensions of partnership.

The signing ceremony for this strategic partnership took place at the North Hall of the Las Vegas Convention Center, the main exhibition venue of CES. Both companies plan to enhance operational efficiency, share key customer channels, expand into new markets, and collaborate on joint research and development of innovative products that amalgamate their groundbreaking technologies.

Xandar Kardian’s radar signal processing sensor technology is currently employed across diverse sectors, from hospitals and long-term care facilities to shopping centers and airports. It measures user patterns and biometric signals, optimizing patient care and management. Ceragem provides home health appliances backed by research, testing, and technological development. Their massage-related products have gained significant popularity globally due to innovative design and effectiveness.

While Xandar Kardian and Ceragem receive high accolades in their respective industries, the unified goal of both companies is to assist people in enjoying a healthy life through innovative technology.

Sam Yang, CEO and Co-founder of Xandar Kardian, expressed delight in partnering with Ceragem, a global leader in home healthcare. He stated, “Over the past few years, our technology has proven not limited to specific environments. Biometric monitoring and occupancy detection technology can provide valuable information across various applications, benefiting patients, operations managers, and the general public. This partnership with Ceragem holds significant potential and possibilities. We look forward to introducing interesting data-driven solutions through collaboration.”

Xandar Kardian and Ceragem plan to enhance their product portfolios and explore new health and wellness solutions centered around radar-based technology, offering rich data. The collaborative pilot program is set to commence in the first half of 2024.
